title.narrative: GLoBe South Africa - Strong local governments implement a coherent waste management strategy enhancing separation at source and economic opportunities with specific attention to vulnerable groups

description.narrative: Bergrivier & Witzenberg: Technical staff and politicians (150p; 35% F - 65% M); low-income households (300 in B and 100 in W); 15 small local entrepreneurs (50% F - 50% M). Beneficiaries: all 189.000 inhabitants, with a focus on women, youth, low-income households and local private actors. SALGA: Technical staff of 25 metros and secondary cities (50p; 40%F - 60%M). Civil society of 25 municipalities (100; 50%F - 50%M). Beneficiaries: all 257 South African local governments and their citizens.

In South Africa, GLoBe is committed to supporting local governments in the development and implementation of qualitive and inclusive waste management strategies. Attention is given to environmentally friendly solutions, and to low-income households, women, youth and small entrepreneurs to strengthen the participation of the most vulnerable in government actions. The VVSG will work with an exit programme in South Africa (2022-23), focusing on consolidating the results and strengthening the capacity of local partners so that they can optimally implement the waste policy, also after the end of the programme. By strengthening local governance on waste, the programme advances healthier and cleaner living environments and boosts decent and viable employment for local stakeholders.
